findings.title: Finite harvest needs a bound node transaction, not another output table
findings.baseline_relation: Macro/Micro already require conserved nodes/lots; this pass names the native admission and settlement boundary.

evidence.claim: Native gathering derives item chance/count and interval from definitions and skill; this function has no finite-node reservation.
Native tick draws with Math.random, credits gathered statistics and inventory, then resets the interval; no regional depletion is joined here.
World definitions accept region IDs/layers, sites, scalar facts and unique claim IDs; they do not expose a resource-node contract.
MC02 already specifies stock reservation, lot condition, partial work and duplicate/stale/publication cases.

findings.current_player_behavior: Existing repeatable professions yield location-specific native materials. Neither these tables nor detached world manifests establish finite regional harvest.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Selected new patches quote exact node/rights/method/tool/body revisions, reserve stock and occupancy, and publish extracted amount, residue, cargo and evidence together. A partial phase retains completed yield and releases only uncut reservations.

acceptance_cases.when: The worker cancels or loses access before the next phase.
acceptance_cases.then: Completed cargo/labor remain; only untouched stock/tool occupancy releases; no whole-job refund plus output.

findings.retain_simplify: Retain native professions, skills, inventory and repeatable opening. Bind only selected new finite patches first.
findings.alternative: For one fixed patch, typed scalar instance facts plus revision-guarded world update, existing job escrow and staged native output may suffice if Engine proves bounds, competing reservations and joint publication. This does not establish generic ecology.

findings.title: Bind availability and renewal to explicit clocks and extraction boundaries
findings.baseline_relation: Plan names seasons/local time; it has not selected admission/completion rules for a changing habitat.

evidence.claim: Village fishing declares Spring/Summer/Autumn availability.
JOB/TRAINING starts call can_work; the GATHERING branch checks the tool slot without calling can_work.
Gathering reward settlement precedes the tick's can_work check.
Native seasonal temperature and deterministic day-count rain cycles already exist.
Local elapsed advances over occupied visit intervals and freezes otherwise.
A paid job completes by applying frozen effects; it does not generally recheck current seasonal/physical support.

findings.current_player_behavior: Native seasonal definitions and eventual stops exist. Static flow permits an unavailable gathering start and places its periodic availability stop after possible rewards; no browser reproduction was run.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: A selected harvest policy declares its clock, window and check points. Commit rejects a closed window; each live extraction phase checks current required support before yield, with paid/frozen work handled by its stated policy. Renewal uses authorized local elapsed; portable viability uses its declared clock.

authoritative_owner.state: Existing native calendar/world clock and selected extraction continuation
authoritative_owner.writer: Shared Engine owns check/order; Regions authors seasonal/habitat policy

world_examples.case: Fishing at the last autumn boundary either finishes a paid legal catch or stops before another catch according to the displayed policy; winter preparation has a useful alternative.
world_examples.status: O policy; native fishing/season declarations are verified

acceptance_cases.when: A direct gathering command bypasses the visible button.
acceptance_cases.then: No harvest begins or produces reward.

acceptance_cases.given: A cut spans window closure and a detached destination is absent.
acceptance_cases.when: The scheduler processes the next phase and later reentry.
acceptance_cases.then: Only legally completed extraction remains; the chosen stop/refund policy applies once; absence freeze produces no secret regrowth.

findings.retain_simplify: Reuse native deterministic calendar/weather and saved clock mappings. Detailed stochastic weather is unnecessary for a first seasonal choice.
findings.alternative: Use one authored wet/dry window and its next boundary, without adding a climate simulator.

source_status.uncertainty: Exact boundary semantics, absent-time exceptions and compensation remain director/Engine choices.

findings.verification_limits: No exploit/runtime claim, changed code or game execution; seasons do not prove habitat growth or due-phase enforcement.

findings.title: Separate harvestable stock from the producer and renewal regime
findings.baseline_relation: MC02 has a ceiling/time/input regrowth rule; producer loss, husbandry and finite-reserve discovery need concrete policies.

evidence.claim: Selective extraction, viable specimens and renewable/slow/finite/unique sites are proposed.
MC02 reserves harvest units and proposes qualified regrowth up to 12 after 40 local minutes.
Orchard work outputs apples and animal care outputs wool; these declarations do not model crop stages or individual sheep.
Willow wood/sap and underwater silver are location output tables with distinct access, intervals and skills.

findings.current_player_behavior: Skill improves chance/count/time/quality in existing professions. Finding an ore table or repeatable wool does not establish the reserve, crop or producer's life.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Declare a local renewal regime: managed service share, regenerative producer, replenished flow, finite deposit or unique claim. A method changes specific retained producer state when relevant. Farming tracks selected planting/care/maturity/harvest causes; prospecting can expose existing inaccessible ore without regenerating it.

authoritative_owner.state: Instance patch/reserve/producer state; promoted living actors only where needed
authoritative_owner.writer: Regions rules and ecology planner; People owns individually represented life; Items owns seed/feed/output

findings.retain_simplify: Track the few lifecycle facts that alter play; background orchards need no per-fruit actor. Existing service shares may stay renewable contracts.
findings.alternative: Use a stage enum and due time for a single tended patch; avoid universal breeding/genetics or growth simulation.

source_status.uncertainty: Renewal inputs, growth timing and ecological realism unselected.

findings.title: Make selected habitats affect neighboring resources and routes through actual causes
findings.baseline_relation: Macro lists terrain/weather/population; a coupled habitat change would give regional interventions a distinct payoff.

evidence.claim: Zones list seasonal modifiers, resources and populations; density and contact are distinct from threat strength.
Temperature uses the current native location and calendar modifiers, not a per-region water/soil/habitat state.
Local weather/scene prose and recurring people's work are supported read models.
An authored one-occurrence shower changes a workbench fact; this is a bounded causal hook, not watershed ecology.

findings.current_player_behavior: Native weather and local authored wet-work conditions provide useful atmosphere and constraints. No inspected function joins an upstream extraction to downstream habitat supply.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: For a selected case, add one typed local cause edge such as disturbed bank -> observed turbidity -> changed fish access/output, or restored channel -> usable water -> tended supply. Settle transfers/losses and elapsed effects with the actual habitat owner. Disturbance can change routes, resources or contact without inventing more creatures.

authoritative_owner.state: Instance habitat/flow ledger linked to patch and route owners
authoritative_owner.writer: Regions planner; Engine due-boundary integration; Bases owns built intervention

findings.retain_simplify: Choose one consequential coupling; terrain labels alone need no ecological simulation.
findings.alternative: An authored threshold/flow at meaningful boundaries is enough for this case; postpone a full food web, fluid physics and terrain deformation.

findings.title: Treat the return leg and cargo-dependent access as regional gameplay
findings.baseline_relation: Macro already preserves travel; this pass adds directed egress and changing access to the harvest decision.

evidence.claim: Native safe-location links are not necessarily symmetric.
Carya Canyon -> Forest road is 300; Forest road -> Canyon is 120. The bridge challenge unlocks local activities.
An underwater silver activity exists; its table is not a dynamic diving/transport/return controller.
Entering native combat locations starts combat unless the caller supplies supported skip behavior.
Graph targets, true travel cost, occupancy and native entry policy are already specified.

findings.current_player_behavior: Real native routes and asymmetric durations already shape access. A schematic mark or known route does not implement a new field session or safe return.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Quote outbound work plus a real directed egress option, actual carried load/transport and selected exposure. At a legal boundary, changed route support offers wait, alternative passage, supported relocation, cache or assistance using real custody. A capable source can genuinely bypass an obstacle it supports.

authoritative_owner.state: Existing native location graph plus Engine route/session/cargo owners
authoritative_owner.writer: Regions authors route conditions; Engine owns travel/body/native entry; Combat owns hostile interruption

world_examples.case: A collector returning from the Canyon budgets the actual 300-minute leg, then chooses carry, paid transport or a permitted cache for bulky output.

acceptance_cases.given: A harvest plan uses the Canyon links and one supported carrying rule.
acceptance_cases.when: The player completes work and returns.
acceptance_cases.then: Outward and return durations use their own authoritative links; tools/cargo/actor reach the actual endpoint once.

acceptance_cases.given: One authored water route changes while cargo is carried.
acceptance_cases.when: The collector chooses a known alternative or supported wait.
acceptance_cases.then: The menu explains the current reason/cost; no map click teleports cargo, guarantees escape or starts unintended native enemy waves.

findings.retain_simplify: Reuse the native graph and a few meaningful pockets; do not require grid pathfinding.
findings.alternative: A route ledger with explicit directions and sparse condition checks supplies this choice before continuous navigation.

source_status.native: current route declarations and entry flow
source_status.uncertainty: Cargo burden, failure and temporary-cache terms unaccepted.

findings.verification_limits: No travel/browser execution; safety, transport and free retreat are not inferred from a safe-zone label.

findings.title: Collectors, prey and residents must spend the same budget without duplicate claims
findings.baseline_relation: Aggregate promotion exists in the plan; resource contention and output timing need one arbitration case.

evidence.claim: Population/cause budgets and promotion from aggregates are already proposed.
A competitor reserves two units, changes node revision and cannot erase settled player cargo.
Existing command previews check actor/participant occupancy, co-location, claims and site capacity.
The craftsman receives actual transferred logs and spends them on an independent job.
Attaching an actor ID requires a real registered actor; it is not a population promotion or budget debit.

findings.current_player_behavior: Real NPC production and occupancy are usable groundwork. Merely attaching a population label/actor ID grants no funded movement, harvesting or finite animal products.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Independent collectors reserve their own time/tools/access and the same available node units. Resolve same-time contenders in one declared stable order. Separate untapped aggregate population, reserved/promoted individuals and departures/deaths. A background sheep share can stay aggregate; capture, named rivalry or personal contact promotes identity before interaction.

authoritative_owner.state: Resource availability with actor/job owners and conserved regional aggregates
authoritative_owner.writer: Regions budgets/planner; People controller/life; Engine arbitration; Society rights; Combat aftermath

world_examples.case: Collect shed material, tend a represented herd, capture a particular animal or hunt; each spends the relevant products/population once.

acceptance_cases.given: A population has six aggregate animals and two are promoted with owned means.
acceptance_cases.when: One is captured and the other leaves or dies.
acceptance_cases.then: Aggregate plus actual live/reserved/departed ledger conserves the six identities; product/loot sources settle only once.

acceptance_cases.given: Player and funded NPC attempt the last shared harvest units at the same due boundary.
acceptance_cases.when: Stable arbitration and a retry run.
acceptance_cases.then: Reserved units are protected; the loser gets a real stop/requote, not hidden depletion of owned cargo; reopening does not reroll priority.

findings.retain_simplify: Keep background output aggregate; do not simulate a person for every anonymous worker or animal. Named actors stay durable.
findings.alternative: One bounded paid collector schedule plus one promotion case can qualify competition before ecosystem-wide AI.

source_status.native: actor/job support; finite ecology absent from inspected contracts
source_status.uncertainty: Arbitration, legal rights and demographic renewal unselected.

findings.title: Known places need dated observations, not perpetual access to current hidden facts
findings.baseline_relation: Dated signals are in the macro proposal; existing projections reveal a specific adapter risk and reusable observation support.

evidence.claim: The knowledge allowlist exposes current instance fact/site values for the admitted keys.
An observation stores a sampled fact and observedAt.
Knowledge retains stage, value, time, cause and optional basis.
Route learning keeps the first origin and does not require replacing that competence.
Replay returns scoped stored receipts without new sampling.

findings.current_player_behavior: Identity disclosure, learned route origin and timestamped knowledge already have owners. Reusing the world allowlist for remote changing patch stock would expose current values after only historical observation.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Show sampled habitat/stock/route evidence with endpoint, local clock, basis and estimation scope. Keep learned competence when conditions change. An old report may open a re-survey, resident report or supported sensor action; current exact stock requires current supported observation. Menu/map/readback share that evidence.

authoritative_owner.state: Existing actor observation/knowledge receipts, referencing actual region revisions
authoritative_owner.writer: Engine projection/observation binding; Regions evidence payload; Experience rendering

acceptance_cases.then: The old timestamped estimate remains; no exact hidden update or new draw occurs. A later legal survey updates evidence and changes a plan.

findings.retain_simplify: Reuse current observations, knowledge basis and replay semantics; no second belief/map engine.
findings.alternative: One last-supported observation per patch plus causal retained important discoveries suffices before a detailed survey history.

source_status.uncertainty: Estimate bounds and automatic evidence-refresh terms unaccepted.

findings.title: Make preservation and transplant support selective regional choices
findings.baseline_relation: Micro's lot/preservation chain is already sufficient; broad freshness/upkeep would add cost without a chosen payoff.

evidence.claim: Suitability and preservation create particular choices; ordinary inventory should avoid constant spoilage management.
A viable cutting, negotiated planting site and useful later supply are proposed.
MC02 gives packaging, preservation, condition and local-time rules.
Detached instance clock supports freeze, not a universal aging clock for carried specimens.

findings.current_player_behavior: Existing ordinary output uses native inventory; inspected region owners do not provide generic freshness, plant establishment or cross-world growth.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Selected delicate samples declare exposure/viability and the clock during travel/storage; pack, process on site, choose a closer service or pay a supplier. A transported living sample establishes a local producer only through compatible site/support, paid work and actual stock transfer. Environmental/resource functions may be superior without invented universal penalties.

authoritative_owner.state: Items lot/condition/custody; Regions recipient habitat; Bases site support
authoritative_owner.writer: Items owns preservation effects; Regions authors establishment predicates; Engine clocks/cargo

world_examples.case: Keep ordinary logs useful without expiry; protect one live cutting or process one delicate sap sample before the actual return leg.
Study an imported specimen's supported habitat, then establish one paid local bed; carrying it does not automatically create an endlessly producing garden.

acceptance_cases.given: An ordinary log and a selected viable sample share cargo.
acceptance_cases.when: Travel, local freeze and supported preservation run.
acceptance_cases.then: Only the selected sample follows its declared active clock/exposure; packaging changes the stated condition once; failed planting retains its actual spent inputs/history.

findings.retain_simplify: Keep ordinary items stable and avoid maintenance across every visited zone. Growing an imported specimen is optional where it creates a new useful route.
findings.alternative: A supported/compromised state and declared viability boundary may suffice; continuous moisture/temperature simulation is optional.

source_status.uncertainty: Exact viability, cross-world support and specimen compatibility remain open.

findings.verification_limits: No new item/biological transport or preservation implementation; no real-world botanical or medical claims.

findings.title: Retain sparse purposeful regions and bounded aggregates as the default resolution
findings.baseline_relation: The macro and wandering owners already reject a compulsory full map. Preserve that simplification during plan merge.

evidence.claim: Adjacency and terrain pockets precede optional coordinates/climate/demographics.
Separate cause/population/strength/contact, with promotion and due-region aggregation.
The center menu is primary; map presentation, bounded wandering and tile simulation have distinct costs.
Existing scheduler computes boundaries and settles ordered due jobs; a regional ecology adapter is not yet among the listed boundaries.

findings.current_player_behavior: The familiar menu, native graph and sparse supported jobs remain coherent. Decorative terrain and background prose carry no extra actor budget or dynamic ecology by themselves.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: An author declares represented patches/routes, actual named actors, conserved aggregates and unsimulated background. Process selected growth/migration/competition only at meaningful authorized boundaries with stable continuation. Add exact positions only for a concrete selected reach/tactic, not for every herb or resident.

authoritative_owner.state: One region manifest/resolution policy referencing existing owners
authoritative_owner.writer: Regions authoring; Shared Engine scheduler; Runtime-efficiency measurement; Experience views

world_examples.case: A town service, managed field, wilderness pocket and finite ruin differ through rights/supply/people/return consequences while all remain playable through ordinary actions.
world_examples.status: O new region content; no grid requirement

acceptance_cases.given: One chosen region has four purposeful nodes, aggregate flow and a promoted named participant.
acceptance_cases.when: Its optional map is hidden; a due boundary is resumed.
acceptance_cases.then: Legal actions/costs/history remain identical; each due cause settles once; no background person or infinite source is silently converted to a finite actor model.

findings.retain_simplify: Retain genuine inexhaustibility/superiority when a selected source supports it. Background stays background; quiet intervals and reliable ordinary supply stay useful.
findings.alternative: A fixed authored patch and one competitor are an honest first approximation; clearly label any unimplemented dynamic habitat/population/geometry.

source_status.uncertainty: No measured runtime/token reduction; workload thresholds require later profiling.

findings.verification_limits: Theoretical reduction in represented state is an inference; no new benchmark, build or gameplay executed.
